message: The other day, I was chatting with my granddaughter about our emergency plans when suddenly her phone died. She looked at me wide-eyed, as if the world had come to a halt! It reminded me how important it is to have our family plans in writing and easily accessible, especially when technology decides to take a nap. 😊 So, I encourage everyone to keep a little notebook with your important info—just in case. Have you thought about how you'd share your plans if your phone went silent?
